name: Legion militiaman
material_note: RI-WPN05 §B: 'metal — Dunmer slaver garrison, Imperial armour'. A legionary is a man in a cuirass: strike and thrust beat slash, and the head is still a head.
_water_note: RI-WLD10 §5 R5 (S25). An Imperial militiaman in a metal cuirass leashes at shin-deep (W2): R5's disengage route, not an invisible wall — this archetype holds at the waterline and reacquires rather than following into the wade band.

weapon._socket_rule_note: socket_a_dist_m is skeleton.json §weapon.socket_rule's grip_offset_m (0.10) because socket_a is wpn_guard. It was 0.30-0.45 in wave 1, which put the near end of the hitbox a third of a metre past the hands and gave every enemy a dead ring in front of its own chest that no pose could close (W1-09 round-4 measurement: min_axis 0.67-0.93 m). capsule_length_m follows from the two sockets.
weapon._peak_declared_note: RI-CMB04 §B declares peak_tip_speed_mps per PLAYER weapon class and nothing for enemies, so the enemy clips were the one part of the build no speed ceiling applied to. Adopted from the §B row whose capsule_length_m is nearest this weapon's (greatsword, 1.35 m). PROVISIONAL: RI-CMB04 owns the column and may re-derive it.

chop.note: P_safe = the 76-frame recovery. A straight sword R1 has Ps 25 f@60 (RI-CMB02 §A), so this window is punishable with 51 frames of slack.

parley.fiction: A militiaman arresting you is doing a job, not settling a score. Yielding works: he takes you in. Seam S13 requires a fight with a person to have a non-lethal exit, and RI-CRM01 §4 band 3 requires that exit to be a SURRENDER specifically — the arrest interaction is the parley, and the three answers (pay, resist, serve) are what it opens onto.
parley.gold_price_note: W1-15 r3, round-2 verdict biggest_gap GAP-W1-crime-enforcement-is-a-free-win: was 0, and combat/parley.js's GOLD ground passes on `gold >= price AND disposition >= 20` — with base_disposition 35 already over that bar, price 0 made a band-3 attack-on-sight guard surrender for free, at full HP, on one `interact` press, with the 3,000 g bounty left standing. Raised to 300 (the verdict's own floor is >=200 g) so buying off a guard costs a real purse instead of nothing. NOT closed by this alone: (1) `combat/parley.js`'s GOLD disposition floor (20) is shared by every parleying NPC in the data, so raising it to the verdict's suggested 40 for guards specifically needs a code change this round did not make; (2) guard_legion's `ai` is `hold_ground`, and `combat/enemy.js` only runs a scripted action for `ai === 'scripted'` — an AGGRO'd guard still deals 0 damage, which is W1-12's (enemy AI) to close, not a data field; (3) an accepted surrender still does not route into `arrestTopics()`/`answerArrest()`, so the bounty is not paid, served or refused by yielding — it is left standing, same as before this fix.

provenance: W1-15 round 2. RI-CRM01 §4 needs a guard that EXISTS: round 1 had no guard entities at all, so getGuardBand() was a pure function of a number setBounty() wrote, the arrest was unreachable, and RI-CRM01 method 7 band 3 ("assert a surrender parley exists in band 3") could only be checked as a string on a record. Frames, hitboxes and moveset are inf_trash's unchanged — this piece does not own combat, and inventing a guard moveset would be exactly the fabrication RI-MTH04 forbids.
_armour_rating_note: Seam S19's consuming system for `corrode` (RI-MAG06 §B: "the rating falls"). A flat subtraction from every incoming damage number, applied in combat/resolve.js at the one site damage is computed. It was 0 everywhere in wave 1, which meant `corrode` had nothing to corrode and measured NOT_OBSERVED. Provisional: RI-CMB01 owns armour as a fight quantity and may re-derive every figure here.
sight_radius_m_source: RI-AI01 §B / detection.json sight_radius_R_m.GUARD = 18 m. A guard looks further than a marsh sentry because looking is the job.
_reactable_note: RI-CMB12 §A: `reactable` is DECLARED HERE, IN ADVANCE, and counts against the archetype's `reactable_share` (>= 0.70). An attack declaring `true` must measure `t_react = f_active - f_vis >= 19 f@60`, where f_vis is the frame the POSE first becomes distinguishable — not the frame the state label changes. Measured by tools/harness/cmb-exchange.mjs --probe react.
_souls_note: DERIVED by tools/progression/derive-soul-values.mjs from this statblock's own hp/poise/armour_rating/attack_rating/tier, scaled by RI-PRG06 §7's census normalisation (576/world.enemy_census, read from corpus/00-doctrine/constants.json) — do not hand-edit, re-run the tool (it has a --check mode that fails if the field and the derivation have drifted, and binds the value to the band of the region the statblock is actually placed in). Read by game/src/sim/souls.js, which is the ONLY producer of soulsHeld apart from recovering your own bloodstain. RI-PRG06 §3 owns the soul budget, RI-PRG01 owns the curve it is spent on, and seam S15 forbids souls buying anything but a level. Props are zero so a 99,999-hp training dummy is not an infinite farm.
